decision: Neither assigned acceptance ID has a truthful source-only gap that can be completed within the two-hour limit and three native attempts. AT-self-improvement-59 already has its bounded public PostgreSQL journal diagnostic; its remaining criterion is an actual seven-day supported-route trial. AT-hermes-config-37 adds a 24-hour host soak before that same seven-day trial. Registration aliasing or more fixture cases would not supply the elapsed, protected, provider, or resource observations required by either assertion.

candidates.gapClassification: The canonical assertion requires the original seven-day 3,360-slot measured arm plus a preliminary 24-hour M2 / 8 GB soak with bounded child and browser fixtures. tests/registry.yaml has no AT-hermes-config-37 probe manifest, and the existing capacityTrialProbe rejects this ID. Merely adding a manifest/dispatch alias would run fixture-only journal diagnostics, not the required soak or trial.
candidates.ownerPath: toy CLI probe.run -> ReplayEnvironment.runRegisteredProbe in packages/self-improvement/src/public.ts -> capacityTrialProbe -> CapacityTrialJournal / DurableCadenceOwner
candidates.boundedConclusion: No source unit can truthfully produce 24 hours plus seven days within the proposed two hours. No existing typed public transport captures the required soak or actual trial observations. Do not add a telemetry subsystem, soak protocol, or fake PASS case.

candidates.existingOwnerBehavior: The public ReplayEnvironment route reaches capacityTrialProbe and CapacityTrialJournal.withTest, backed by the real PostgreSQL fixture. Its 14 public CheckViews verify immutable 3,360-slot arm bindings, refusal/idempotency, fake-time boundary reconciliation, restart readback, and separate original/experimental denominators.
candidates.boundedConclusion: There is no missing small owner oracle to implement for the already-registered fixture journal case. The current arm/report contracts fix acceptanceComplete=false and fullCadenceVerdict=NOT_EVALUATED, while the probe explicitly publishes fake_model, zero provider sends, and liveTrialStarted=false. It cannot certify actual requests/observed route settings, accepted reviews, allowance freshness, latency, RAM/swap, or uninterrupted elapsed coverage. The remaining assertion is the actual seven-day protected supported-route trial; adding more journal fixtures would duplicate the passed bounded unit and leave the premise unmet.

existingLedgerFloorReview.relevance: This is a separate durable-cadence owner/schema floor. Its handoff explicitly defers seven-day original-policy cadence acceptance and does not replace or satisfy AT-hermes-config-37 or AT-self-improvement-59. Do not reimplement its six checks.

publicInterfaceOwnership.recommendation: No source owner. Keep the existing AT-self-improvement-59 case unchanged. Do not create an AT-hermes-config-37 manifest that maps to the same fake journal diagnostics. If the real elapsed prerequisites later complete, use the existing public journal/report path and capture actual owner receipts; parent owns registry/generation/integration and the full CLI proof. No new module, DTO, protocol, worker telemetry, queue, threshold, or service is justified by this review.

doctor.scope: Helper resource admission only; it does not authorize source work or change the elapsed trial premise.
